stage.how: Login Tata SAP (DFPL plant code). Post FG GRN: material code (SKU), lot no., qty (master bags x bag weight), production date, batch no. SAP transfer also required: RM to Packing to FG — system-level transfer. GRN no. noted. Screenshot filed in Drive. Do NOT delay — QA cannot release FG until GRN is posted. SAP sequence: RM → Packing → FG transfer mandatory (system transfer, separate from physical GRN). SAP FG GRN + System Transfer (Bhupendra) GRN no. + screenshot filed. QA release only after this.
